pin.estimand: recertification token_delta of no-delegation / one-hop-delegation-allowed over 8 fresh pairs (4 per marker) against the construct's own declared careful-English clauses, value = least-favourable (closest-to-zero) mean across tiktoken cl100k_base and o200k_base (0.13.0), subjects disjoint from the row's visible pair set
admissibility_gates: abort if any frozen pair breaks info-equivalence (arms carrying different facts), naming the defect
abort if tiktoken cannot supply both pinned lineages at run time
abort if the frozen digest 4322f522afc4f64c... fails to reproduce from the pairs at run time

attempt.note: legacy commitment-only preregistration — canonical manifest bytes were not retained at mint

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

design.selection: all pairs fixed and digest 4322f522afc4f64c12c2e0ab0986d5ea0185dae07ae1fe4efa295078c5e010cd pinned BEFORE any token count; recertification era (post-0.33.0 register), no replicates_hash — a fresh original re-arming the veto
design.freshness: 8 NEW pairs; subjects (postmortem, TLS renewal, candidate interview, ledger reconciliation, metrics backfill, asset migration, bug triage, archive indexing) disjoint from the row's visible 8-pair set 7ca388b7; the four pointer-shaped prior sets are masked, so disjointness from them rests on independent authorship
design.estimand_pin: token_delta = tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) per matched pair; english arm = ACTION + the construct's own declared careful-English clause (no-delegation: must not assign any completion-bearing part to a different principal; one-hop: may hand completion-bearing parts to direct delegates who may not delegate further, accountability retained); mean per tokenizer over the pinned 8; value = least favourable (closest-to-zero) tokenizer mean, mirroring the row's prior convention
